title: •Where Are Those Droidekas?!
caption: •Where Are Those Droidekas?! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Scum And Villainy is canceled. Non-unique destroyer droids are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. While all your characters at sites are destroyer droids, opponent’s characters are defense value -1 for each destroyer droid present. {alter}
lore: When two Jedi are attempting to breach your bridge, even a destroyer droid’s response time seems far too slow.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub: 'Immune to Alter'). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. CREDITS: printed in italic BELOW the text box (above the caption bar), not in the side margins — left 'Original concept by Alden Peterson', right 'GenCon 2005'; recorded as margin_left / margin_right per the brief (renderer may need a below-the-box placement). Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in droid’s (wiki straight; apostrophe shape not clearly resolvable on the scans — Decipher's usual curly assumed). Copyright '… 2001 DECIPHER INC.' legible on the V8 745 px face. Base scan 350 px. Modern: V8-D-wherearethosedroidekas.gif (745 px); VB5 (350) also exists, not downloaded.
